factory.description: The industrial estate and facilities of Chemical Plant No. 16 were rented out illegally to the TerraGroup corporation. During the advent of the Contract Wars, the plant became the scene of numerous firefights between BEAR and USEC that ultimately determined control over the industrial district of Tarkov. Later on, in the wake of the chaos, the plant facilities became a shelter for the remaining civilians, Scavs, and military operatives, including the scattered remains of the BEAR and USEC contingents.

shoreline.description: The Shoreline area makes up a large part of the outskirts of Tarkov and is located next to the Port. The area houses a partially abandoned village, modern private housing, agricultural fields, long stretches of beach, a boating facility, gas station, weather station, and a cellular tower as well as other commercial facilities. Shoreline's main point of interest is the Azure Coast health resort which consists of several blocks, exclusively powered by a nearby hydroelectric power plant. The resort had previously been used as temporary accommodation for members of TerraGroup and the corporation's associated divisions in preparation for the evacuation of the Tarkov Port.

In experienced matchmaking there are the following differences:
* Chance to find rare loot
* Increased Scavs difficulty
* Cultists can appear

icebreaker.description: In the Gulf of Finland, trapped within the blockade surrounding Tarkov, lies the nuclear-powered icebreaker "Boreas", owned by the logistics corporation Paradigm Shipping. The exact purpose of "Boreas" and the cargo it carries remain unknown. It appears that Paradigm Shipping and TerraGroup made special efforts to minimize any mention of the icebreaker in the press and keep its routes and assignments classified.
icebreaker.notes:
* This location can initially only be entered through transiting from Lighthouse or Shoreline after unlocking it in the story chapter Boreas. The transits are located at the piers and require a Sudak-Tudak marine repair kit.

terminal.description: The southern port Terminal has been under Russian Armed Forces control since the beginning of the Tarkov conflict. After the city was sealed off, the terminal was fortified and became the primary evacuation point, sought by both civilian refugees and PMC units. According to unconfirmed reports, TerraGroup personnel were also evacuated through this port.
terminal.notes:
* When leaving this location by either dying or extracting, the state of the character is returned as it was before entering, besides the consumed access item.
 
* This location can only be entered through transiting from Shoreline in the time period of 21:00-6:00 after presenting an access item at the port garrison intercom.
